column6: NSF STTR Phase I award "Eco-Friendly Polyimides for Next-Gen Flexible Circuitry" to EnduraCure LLC, PI Dennis Pruzan, project period Oct 2025-Sept 2026, confirming the company is an active grant recipient.
Hexcel Corp 10-Q for quarter ended June 30 2026, filed with SEC EDGAR July 29 2026, reporting $529.3M net sales and raised full-year guidance.
Health Catalyst Inc 10-Q for Q2 2026 accepted by SEC August 6 2026, reporting revenue, goodwill impairment, and Vitalware divestiture close.
Energy Fuels Inc (NYSE American: UUUU) 10-Q for quarter ended June 30 2026, filed early August 2026, reporting $25.1M Q2 revenue; White Mesa Mill is the company's central operating asset.

Federal Register notice of Energy Solutions LLC's NRC application (filed June 5 2026) to import Class A low-level radioactive waste from Ontario, Canada to the Clive, Utah disposal facility; comment period runs to Sept 2026.

Epitel closed a $26M Series B financing (co-led by Catalyst Health Ventures and Genoa Ventures) announced July 28 2026 to expand REMI wireless EEG monitoring; also picked up a March 2025 FDA 510(k) clearance expansion to pediatric ages.

Looked for a dated company artifact: evobio.com is a near-empty landing page with no dated content; BioUtah member listing returns HTTP 410 Gone; Altitude Lab portfolio lists it as an "alumni" company founded 2021 with no activity date; no funding, partnership, hiring, or press coverage found in 2025-2026 searches. Cannot tell if the company is quietly operating or wound down.
FamilySearch newsroom release dated 2 March 2026 announcing RootsTech 2026 (5-7 March, Salt Palace and online), hosted by FamilySearch with CEO Steve Rockwood as a keynote.
Business Wire 4 Aug 2026: Fortem selected as prime contractor on DHS five-year C-UAS IDIQ Track 1 (ceiling ~$1.01B); ordering period cited as Aug 2026-Jul 2031 in independent coverage.

Furnace (founders Porter Gardiner and Kyle Nelson) pitched automated cold email at Scale STG Startup Fridays in St. George, April 2025; site live with pricing/FAQ but no dated company artifact newer than that event found.
Globous Relief Fund (EIN 84-1369453) Form 990 for FY ending Dec 2024 filed with IRS Nov 15 2025, showing $5.09M revenue and $9.85M expenses; org news pages also dated Dec 8 2025.

Halda published an April 2026 product Release Radar (engagement scores, Salesforce mapping templates, custom-domain landing pages), a dated version bump showing the enrollment platform still shipping.
Halia PR Newswire June 15 2026: FDA Fast Track for ofirnoflast (HT-6184) in lower-risk MDS following Phase 2 data presented at EHA 2026; CEO Dave Bearss quoted.

EIN Presswire Oct 9 2025: Helpside merged with High Road PEO (Idaho); CEO Rick Bartholomew quoted; work continues under Helpside (clients to Helpside tools Jan 1 2026). Careers page loads but listings undated.

Deseret News Feb 26 2026 covers Hope4Utah/Hope Squad conferences at Mountain View High (Orem) on Feb 19 2026 and founder Greg Hudnall commenting on SB34 suicide-prevention funding; independent photos of the training.

HCI official podcast dated Mar 17 2026 featuring CEO Bradley Cairns and oncologist Conan Kinsey on ongoing lab and clinical work; Vineyard comprehensive cancer center also under construction toward 2028 opening.
KUTV Mar 30 2026: CEO Kyle Case on Talkin Sports; 39th annual Huntsman World Senior Games set for St. George October 2026 with pre-registration open at seniorgames.net.
Hypercraft-Baker Engineering co-development agreement dated Dec 8 2025 to jointly field hybrid-electric defense vehicles; CEO Brian Bowers quoted. Follows a June 2025 $26M Series A.
EdWeek Market Brief Aug 5 2026: Imagine Learning acquired Wayside Publishing (world-language curriculum); CEO Jonathan Grayer quoted. HQ is Tempe; Utah employment footprint still undocumented.
SATIM press release May 4 2026 announcing partnership with Springville-based IMSAR to run OREC object detection on IMSAR UAV SAR sensors; IMSAR president Larry Moore quoted.
